items.title: Source confirms that the Hawks will be waiving Keshon Gilbert (though they haven't yet).
items.author: Brad Rowland
items.body_excerpt:
Source confirms that the Hawks will be waiving Keshon Gilbert (though they haven't yet).

Gilbert had a procedure on his left knee on Nov. 5 and the team said he'd be re-evaluated in ~6 weeks.

Gilbert originally signed in March and appeared in 1 game with the Hawks last season.

quote.author: Michael Scotto
quote.text: The Atlanta Hawks plan to waive two-way guard Keshon Gilbert, league sources told HoopsHype. Gilbert has been listed out with left knee inflammation/non-surgical procedure.

quote.author: Brad Rowland
quote.text:
First official Hawks injury report of the season ahead of Wednesday’s opener in Orlando:

Mouhamed Gueye (left foot fracture) is out.

Henri Veesaar (torn right ACL) is out.
